body:
GitHub https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1490

## Summary
Two follow-ups to additional-repository anchors (#1243), found on a 4-repository corpus:
1. A repository can be pinned at only one revision. Records citing an older revision of an already-declared repository cannot be anchored: a second `additional_repositories` entry with the same root commit is refused, and a scope at that revision is attributed to the primary repository.
2. `docs_locate` takes only `path`/`paths`. In a multi-repository corpus the same relative path can exist in several repositories (e.g. `README.md`, `package.json`, `config/x.yml`) and the request cannot say which one is meant.

## Environment
- Build: main-ef2a01d. Primary repository + 4 additional repositories; 102 records cite one repository at an older revision.

## Reproduction
1. Manifest with additional repository B pinned at `revB2`, plus scopes at `revB1` (an ancestor in B) -> refused (`repository identity mismatch` / revision attributed to the primary).
2. Repositories A and B both contain `docs/README.md`, each anchored by a subject. `docs_locate {path: "docs/README.md"}` returns both with no way to restrict to B.

## Measured
82 of 102 older-revision references could be re-pinned because their blob is unchanged; 20 had to be dropped.

## Expected
- An additional repository may declare more than one revision (within the eight-revision bound), each verified in the same checkout's object store; freshness compares only the declared current revision.
- `docs_locate` (and `docs_recommend_tests`) accept an optional `repository` (root-commit id) per path; without it, results group by repository.

## Acceptance tests
- Two revisions of B: anchors at both build; an anchor at the older revision reports that revision in citations.
- `docs_locate {path, repository: B}` returns only B's subjects; without `repository`, each result names its repository.
